correctness.rationale: Distinct values in different phases make K zero-distance neighbours equivalent to a residue multiplicity inequality. Exact training count is c_T(p)=max(0,1+floor((T-Y-H-p)/P)). At T-Y-H=(K-1)P+r-1 exactly r/P of full-period test starts are saturated. Stride d visits residues of one coset modulo gcd(P,d); the stated formula g/P times the intersection cardinality follows from modular orbit counting. With r=1, stride d=P selects exclusively saturated phase, yielding sample fraction 1 vs full fraction 1/P and maximal gap 1-1/P; coprime d over full orbit is unbiased. Independently verified 2376 (P,K,Y,H,stride) parameter instances. Assumptions include from-start exact periodicity, no Theiler exclusion and full stride cycles.
